method: Post-draft check against full-check receipt, failed-test log, matched baseline diagnostics and staged/source diff
score_reason: Concrete counts and failures dominate; receipt structure remains formal.
confidence_reason: Self-review, not an authorship or human-style test.

examples.quote: The suite reported FAIL 1, WARN 60, SKIP 1259 and PASS 26633. Its single failing assertion is test-example-behavioural-reaction-norm.R:194: max_gradient expected PASS but was WARN. A targeted reproduction using the checked installation and the unchanged source-161abe09 pilot binary returned the same result in both: optimiser code 0, raw max gradient 0.01817 above the unchanged 0.01 threshold. The fixture MD5 and recorded objective agree. This establishes a pre-existing local baseline failure, not a documentation regression. It is retained rather than hidden, skipped or repaired by changing defaults or test thresholds.
examples.cue: Exact failing check and unchanged-baseline evidence
examples.impact: Makes the local failure and merge gate explicit
